title: Remote Control Single-Press Selection & Live TV Category Stability
releaseNotes:
• Single-Press Selection: Fixed remote control select/OK double-press requirement across all cards and buttons by removing redundant focusable modifiers, eliminating focus shifts, and capturing KeyDown events
• Full Remote & Gamepad Coverage: Added KEYCODE_BUTTON_A and KEYCODE_BUTTON_SELECT support alongside D-pad Center, Enter, and Numpad Enter
• Live TV Category Stability: Fixed unintended category jumping when selecting a channel to play by removing clearFocus and category onFocusChanged auto-selection
• VOD Focus Protection: Eliminated clearFocus calls in Movies and Series to ensure stable remote D-pad focus during playback launch and dialog interactions
